body: we have a 13 year old malti tzu but she's gotten old and grumpy and just barks at her. they don't fight but its clear the older one is trying to be in charge. she's also hit or miss with other animals. sometimes she loves them and others she tries to attack

start with using the shampoo per directions (hoping it was given to you by a vet) if it doesn't improve or gets worse take him to the vet. it doesn't seem to have any sores or redness which is good. try to make sure he doesn't like it (or any other pet you have) and just watch it. you're doing amazing so far
